LanguageData.NSIF_FridgeGiftLetterText:
The Nivarian mothership has delivered a refrigerator to your colony!

It has landed safely and is ready to store food. You can also enable its fridge bed manually to give your Nivarians a cool place to rest.

Tynan's 1.7 update means Fridge Sleeping and Icecream Tail need a rewrite, hehehehehehehehehehehehehe! Like my Unity effects in 1.6? I'm going to fire a refrigerator down to every Nivarian colony, hehehehehehehehehehehehehe!
